dogecoin.text: According to report, Dogecoin gains momentum as whales accumulate 100M DOGE, bullish projections emerge, and research suggests a 1% allocation to DOGE can enhance portfolio returns to 8.95% annually.
JUST IN: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has acknowledged a Dogecoin (DOGE) exchange-traded fund (ETF) filing by 21Shares.
